title: .fact-gate.json
description: Project configuration for fact-gate: the source of truth every AI-written document in this repository is checked against.

facts.description: Structured facts, or a path to a JSON file holding them. Any value may be a measurement instead of a literal.

source.description: Path to a prose source of truth (relative to this file).

jd.description: Path to reference text the model was shown; figures echoed from it are not self-claims.

include.description: Extensions (".md"), file names, or directory prefixes ("docs/") to check. Default: .md .mdx .markdown .txt .rst .adoc

exclude.description: Extensions, file names, or directory prefixes never checked.

nouns.description: Extra countable nouns for your domain.

warnUnsupported.description: Show unsupported claims to the agent as a system message (never blocks).

allow_metrics.description: Figures confirmed true that the facts do not state. Audited: an entry that rescues nothing is reported.

measurement.description: A value derived at check time rather than typed.

cmd.description: Shell command; its stdout+stderr is searched with `pattern`.

json.description: JSON file; `path` selects a value (dotted, with .length / .keys).

pattern.description: Regular expression; the first capture group (or `group`) is the value.

counts.description: "<qualifiers> <noun>" → number. The noun is the last vocabulary word; a trailing "+" marks a lower bound.

experience_start.description: YYYY-MM — earliest role start, for tenure claims.
